requirements_summary: Workload: semantic search for product catalog + embeddings for user personalization and recommendations.
Throughput targets: 400 qps read (production retrieval), sustained embedding ingest of ~2M documents/night (~500-1,000 docs/sec during windows) or batched offline.
Latency SLOs: 95th percentile < 120ms for retrieval; < 250ms for reranking calls.
Throughput/cost tradeoffs: need intelligent batching, KV/prefix caching to lower per-token cost.
Vector DB integration: must support Postgres+pgvector (current), evaluate Pinecone and managed options; want migration path and connector examples.
Batch jobs: orchestrated nightly jobs (Airflow) to compute embeddings; require idempotent upserts & backfill support.
Model preferences: open models and quantized variants; fallback routing to smaller model under contention.
Security/compliance: SAML SSO, SOC2 attestation, KMS for key management, audit logging and 1-year retention, US data residency.
Operational needs: per-route cost/latency breakdown, tracing for query bottlenecks, canary rollouts for model updates.
